name: @penguinharness/rsi-awm
description: The AWM RSI Toolkit: Agent Workflow Memory (Wang et al., 2024) — workflows are induced from successful trajectories and stored in the Target's memory, online over a training stream or offline from supplied experiences, then frozen for independent testing on the Benchmark. Self-contained: it creates the Target's workflow memory, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.
